conventions.bar_close_only: All conditions are evaluated on CLOSED bars. 'enter at close' = fill at that bar's close (or next bar open as a conservative variant). Intrabar stop/target hits must be resolved with a lower timeframe (1m data available) or a worst-case rule (stop first).
conventions.R: R = |entry - stop|. Target 'kR' = entry + k*R for longs.
conventions.pivots: Any swing high/low uses pivot(left=L, right=R); a pivot at bar t-R becomes usable only at bar t (no look-ahead). L and R are UNSPECIFIED in the videos unless stated.
conventions.unspecified: Fields named 'unspecified_params' list parameters the video did not state, with a suggested test range. Values given elsewhere are stated in the video.
conventions.solt_adaptation: Videos target BTC/ETH spot/perp scalps/swings. For SOLT, compute the signal on BTC or SOL (Binance) and execute SOLT at the next available US session price (incl. pre/after-market); test both the video's own exit and our preset SOLT profit multiples (1.5x, 2x, 3x) with the video's stop. These adaptations are ours, not the videos'.

meta.data_notes: Binance 1m parquet files include tbv (taker-buy base volume), so CVD = cumsum(2*tbv - v) is computable; volume profile can be built from 1m bars.

candidates.name: Ross Cameron RSI double bottom (RSI 쌍바닥)
candidates.source_title: 80만원으로 150억, 진짜 RSI 매매전략 [로스 카메론 RSI 쌍바닥 매매법]
candidates.indicators: RSI(14, close) [video: 'use default settings']; Bollinger Bands(20, 2.0, close) [video: default BB, params not spoken]; engulfing candles

definitions.bullish_engulfing: bar[i-1] bearish (close<open) AND bar[i] bullish (close>open) AND close[i] >= open[i-1] AND open[i] <= close[i-1] (body of i covers body of i-1)

candidates.entry: Long state machine. (1) SETUP ('yellow candle'): a bar s with RSI(14)[s] < 30 AND close[s] < lowerBB[s] AND (bar s is a bearish engulfing OR bars s-2,s-1,s are three consecutive bearish candles). First bottom low L1 = min(low) from s until the first bullish engulfing. (2) FIRST REVERSAL: a bullish engulfing bar e1 after s. (3) SECOND BOTTOM: after e1, price pulls back (at least one bar with close < close[e1] or a new local low) forming second bottom low L2 = min(low) after e1; L2 may be higher OR lower than L1, but the second-bottom bar must be INSIDE the band: low >= lowerBB on that bar (strict variant) [alternative: close >= lowerBB]. (4) TRIGGER: a bullish engulfing bar e2 at/after the second bottom whose own low or previous bar's low equals L2 -> enter long at close[e2].
candidates.exit: Take profit at entry + 3R (video). Our variants: SOLT preset multiples.
candidates.short_mirror: RSI>70, bullish engulfing or 3 consecutive bullish bars closing above upper BB, bearish engulfing, second top inside band, bearish engulfing at second top -> short at close; stop above second top; target 3R.

unspecified_params.inside_band_test: low>=lowerBB vs close>=lowerBB (video wording 'stopped inside the band' suggests low)
unspecified_params.RSI_condition_at_second_bottom: not required by video; optional test RSI>30 at L2 (bullish divergence)
unspecified_params.reset_rule: not stated; suggest: cancel setup if a new bar closes below lowerBB with RSI<30 after e1 (treat as new setup)

candidates.claimed_performance: Two long examples hit +6% within ~half a day; one short +6% within hours. No statistics. Selected examples.
candidates.relevance: HIGH for bottom-catching: formalizes capitulation (close below lower band, RSI<30) -> relief bounce -> retest that holds inside the band -> reversal candle. Stop below the retest low defines risk. Fixed-R target maps directly onto preset-multiple exits.
candidates.weaknesses: In extended bear markets, 1h double bottoms recur many times (series of stops) -> pair with a higher-timeframe capitulation filter (daily drawdown, funding, MVRV, Fear&Greed). 3R on 1h is a few % — far smaller than SOLT 1.5x-3x targets. No repainting; low parameter count.

candidates.name: CHoCH + order-block retest with volume (추세전환·매물대, simplified Smart Money Concepts)
candidates.source_title: 트레이딩뷰 1등 지표, 어려운 용어 없이 신호 하나로 쓰는 매매법 [추세전환·매물대]
candidates.entry: Long: (1) Market in downtrend (last structure break bearish, i.e., most recent confirmed swing lows descending). (2) Bullish CHoCH: a bar c whose CLOSE exceeds the most recent confirmed swing high. (3) Volume[c] > 1.5 * SMA(volume, 20) computed over the 20 bars before c (video: 'more than 1.5x the average of the previous twenty candles'). Only then an order-block box is created. (4) Order-block box = range [low, high] of the candle 'at the lowest point where orders concentrated' before the CHoCH move — implement as the last bearish (close<open) candle at or immediately before the lowest low between the broken swing high and bar c (standard SMC OB). (5) Later, price returns into the box (low <= box_top) and a bar closes BULLISH (close>open) with close inside the box (box_bottom <= close <= box_top) -> enter long at that close.
candidates.exit: Take profit at 2R (video default); video used 3R when 'trend has just reversed strongly' (subjective) -> test 2R and 3R. Orders are set at entry and not managed further. Our variants: SOLT preset multiples.
candidates.short_mirror: Bearish CHoCH (close below last swing low) with volume >1.5x SMA20 -> bearish OB (last bullish candle at the highest high) -> price rallies into box and closes bearish inside -> short; stop max(box_top, signal_high); 2R.

unspecified_params.pivot_left_right: not stated; LuxAlgo SMC defaults are internal=5 and swing=50; test L=R in {3,5,10} on 4h
unspecified_params.order_block_definition: not stated beyond 'lowest point where orders concentrated'; test (a) last bearish candle before impulse, (b) the candle with the lowest low before CHoCH
unspecified_params.box_expiry: not stated; test 10-60 bars; invalidate box if a bar closes below box_bottom
unspecified_params.downtrend_precondition: implied ('price came down a long way'); test: lower-low sequence or close < SMA200

candidates.claimed_performance: Three consecutive signals on BTC 4h: +3.12%, +2.16%, +11.75% (the 3R trade nearly stopped out, hit target ~2 weeks later). Presenter claims they are consecutive, not cherry-picked. No statistics.
candidates.relevance: HIGH: first long example is exactly capitulation low -> high-volume break of prior swing high -> retest of the bottom order block. Buys the higher-low retest with stop under the bottom.
candidates.weaknesses: Pivot confirmation lag (must not use unconfirmed pivots). OB definition ambiguous (curve-fit risk). Few signals. Original SMC indicators redraw boxes; implement causally.

candidates.name: Fibonacci golden-zone pullback after structure flip (피보나치 가이드라인)
candidates.source_title: 매매초보 → 개고수 차트분석가, 꼭 익혀야 할 트레이더 전략 3가지 [추세선·이평선·피보나치] (3rd method)
candidates.entry: Long: (1) Structure flips up: after a decline, price breaks above the previous confirmed swing high ('goes above the immediately previous high'). (2) After a NEW swing high B is confirmed, anchor A = the swing low that started this up-move (the bottom). (3) Golden zone = [B - 0.618*(B-A), B - 0.5*(B-A)]. (4) Wait for a bar whose low touches the zone and which closes as a bullish candle (close>open) leaving a lower wick (and not closing below the zone) -> enter long at the NEXT bar's open. If price traverses the zone without a bullish rejection candle -> no trade.
candidates.exit: Take profit at B (fib 0, the swing high). Our variants: SOLT preset multiples.
candidates.short_mirror: Structure flips down, anchor high->low, wait for rally into 0.5-0.618 and a bearish rejection candle, short next open, stop above the high, target the low.

unspecified_params.pivot_left_right: not stated; test L=R in {3,5,10} on 1h
unspecified_params.bullish_candle_close_location: not stated (inside zone or above); test both
unspecified_params.min_lower_wick: not stated; test none vs wick >= 30% of range
unspecified_params.setup_expiry: not stated; cancel if a new higher swing high forms before entry (re-anchor) or after 48 bars

candidates.claimed_performance: Video states a backtest: BTC 1h, last 2 years, 45 entries, 28 hit target before stop (62%), fees excluded. Plus 3 consecutive example wins.
candidates.relevance: HIGH: codifies buying the first higher low after a capitulation bottom with stop under the bottom; target = first reaction high.
candidates.weaknesses: Reward:risk ~1.0 (entry at 0.5) to ~1.6 (entry at 0.618), below 1.0 if the next-bar open fills above the zone; 62% (n=45, fees excluded) needs verification after costs. Pivot confirmation lag. Parameters undisclosed.

candidates.name: Downtrend-line breakout (추세선 지표)
candidates.source_title: 매매초보 → 개고수 차트분석가, 꼭 익혀야 할 트레이더 전략 3가지 [추세선·이평선·피보나치] (1st method)
candidates.indicators: Trendline through confirmed pivot highs (wick highs)
candidates.entry: Long: draw a descending line through the two most recent confirmed pivot highs (wick highs) with the second lower than the first; extend it forward. When a bar CLOSES above the line's value at that bar (wick-only crosses ignored) -> enter long at that close.
candidates.exit: Target = signal_bar_high + D (indicator's 'Target' line; formula not disclosed). Our variants: SOLT preset multiples.
candidates.stop: signal_bar_low - D (video: stop is the same distance below the candle low as the target is above the candle high).
candidates.short_mirror: Ascending line through pivot lows; close below -> short; target low - D; stop high + D.

unspecified_params.band_width: indicator draws a band (likely ATR-based slope as in LuxAlgo 'Trendlines with Breaks'); test zero width vs 0.5*ATR(14)
unspecified_params.D_target_distance: not stated; test D = k*ATR(14) with k in {1,1.5,2,3} or D = signal bar range
unspecified_params.min_line_length: video example: month-long decline; test minimum 20-100 bars between pivots

candidates.claimed_performance: One BTC 4h segment: 3 signals, all hit Target first. No statistics.
candidates.relevance: HIGH-MEDIUM: close above a multi-week descending trendline is a classic end-of-decline confirmation after capitulation.
candidates.weaknesses: Many free parameters (curve-fit risk); pivot lag; LuxAlgo-type trendlines may repaint historically.

candidates.name: Alex Gonzalez HMA(100) retest / slope flip (HMA 리테스트)
candidates.indicators: Hull MA length 100 on close. Color: rising if HMA[t] > HMA[t-1] (blue), else falling (pink).
candidates.entry: Long: (1) GRAY DOT: while HMA is falling, a bar closes above HMA. (2) ENTRY: the first subsequent bar on which HMA turns rising (HMA[t] > HMA[t-1] and HMA[t-1] <= HMA[t-2]) -> enter long at that bar's close. (Video also says the blue candle that closes a short is itself a long entry, so test with and without the gray-dot prerequisite.)
candidates.exit: Exit at the close of the first bar on which HMA turns falling again (pink). Our variants: SOLT preset multiples.
candidates.stop: Previous swing low ('직전 저점'; example was 3.8% below entry).
candidates.short_mirror: HMA rising, bar closes below HMA (gray dot), then HMA turns falling -> short at close; stop at previous swing high (example 6% above); exit when HMA turns rising.

unspecified_params.previous_low_definition: not stated; test lowest low of last 5, 10, 20 bars or last confirmed pivot low (L=R=3)
unspecified_params.HMA_length_on_intraday: video uses 100 on daily only; for 4h/1h test 100 and 100*bars-per-day equivalents

candidates.claimed_performance: On a BTC daily bear->bull turn: EMA100 close-above came at +20% from the low (49th bar); HMA100 turned up at +12% from the low (14th bar). ETH top: HMA turned down 16% below top (7th bar) vs EMA 21%. Trades: long +59% (vs +7.6% with fixed 1:2), short +15.9%, follow-on long +28%. Gray-dot-only entry example lost 29%.
candidates.relevance: MEDIUM-HIGH: daily HMA100 up-turn as cycle-bottom confirmation; video's own numbers let us measure 'distance from low at entry'. Causal, no repainting.
candidates.weaknesses: Length 100 given without justification; late on daily (tens of % for SOL); exit logic is trend-trailing, not a fixed target.

candidates.name: Fabio Valentini absorption / CVD divergence at POC (파비오 흡수 괴리)
candidates.indicators: CVD = cumulative(taker_buy_vol - taker_sell_vol) = cumsum(2*tbv - v) from Binance 1m; anchored volume profile POC; swing pivots for anchoring
candidates.entry: Long (A setup): (1) Anchor a volume profile at the most recent trend inflection point (confirmed swing low/high) and compute POC (highest-volume price bin) from anchor to now; band color blue if summed delta in the window > 0. (2) Bullish divergence: price rising from the low (higher low / higher close) while CVD is falling over the same window. (3) A bar closes above the POC band AND CVD turns up (CVD[t] > CVD[t-1] after a local CVD low). All three -> enter long at that bar's close.
candidates.exit: Take profit at 4R (video). Our variants: SOLT preset multiples.
candidates.short_mirror: Price falling while CVD rising (distribution/trapped buyers), bar closes below POC band, CVD turns down -> short; stop previous swing high; 4R.
candidates.other_rules: Reduce size (half) before US cash-equity open (09:30 ET); counter-trend trades only with smallest (C) size.

unspecified_params.inflection_point_pivot: not stated; test L=R in {5,10,20} bars on 15m
unspecified_params.POC_band_width: not stated; test POC bin +/- 1 bin or value area 10%
unspecified_params.A_B_C_thresholds: not stated (based on buy/sell imbalance in window); test |sum delta|/sum volume terciles

candidates.claimed_performance: Trader's Robbins World Cup returns 69%, ~90%, 218%, 169%. Two example trades hit 4R. No backtest of the indicator rules.
candidates.relevance: MEDIUM-HIGH conceptually: absorption (CVD keeps falling while price stops making lower lows) is the micro-signature of capitulation lows. Computable from 1m tbv; could serve as a filter for candidates 1-3.
candidates.weaknesses: Very high parameter freedom (the video itself calls profile-window choice a trap) -> high curve-fit risk. True order-flow absorption needs L2/tick data; 1m taker-buy CVD is an approximation. Anchor pivots confirmed only after R bars.

candidates.name: Weekly VWAP slope turn — 'VWAP 신호등' (Humbled Trader / Lance Breitstein)
candidates.indicators: Weekly-anchored VWAP (resets every Monday; typical price (H+L+C)/3 weighted by volume). Slope: up if VWAP[t] > VWAP[t-1].
candidates.entry: Long: VWAP was falling and turns up at bar t (VWAP[t] > VWAP[t-1] and VWAP[t-1] <= VWAP[t-2]). After bar t closes, enter at the open of bar t+1.
candidates.exit: Sell 50% at entry + 3R; hold the remaining 50% until VWAP turns down (exit at next open after the turn-down bar closes). Our variants: SOLT preset multiples.
candidates.stop: Low of the turn bar t.
candidates.short_mirror: VWAP rising then turns down -> short next bar; stop = turn-bar high; 50% at 3R, rest when VWAP turns up.

unspecified_params.week_anchor_timezone: not stated (TradingView exchange time); use UTC Monday 00:00 for Binance
unspecified_params.skip_after_reset: video warns early-Monday signals are noisy but gives no rule; test skipping first 0, 6, 24 hours of the week
unspecified_params.slope_noise_filter: not stated; test minimum slope change or 2-bar confirmation

candidates.claimed_performance: None (concept examples only). Risk 1% of account per trade.
candidates.relevance: MEDIUM: weekly VWAP turning up after a capitulation week signals that the average buyer of the week is back in profit; tight stop at turn-bar low.
candidates.weaknesses: Reset artifacts; VWAP slope rarely turns late in the week (time-of-week bias); chop produces repeated stops (acknowledged).

candidates.name: Emmanuel 20/200 squeeze (임마누엘 스퀴즈)
candidates.source_title: 이평선 단 2개로 8억을 번 트레이더의 매매법 [임마누엘 스퀴즈 매매전략]
candidates.indicators: SMA(20) and SMA(200) on close (video describes simple averages of closes). SMA200 rising if SMA200[t] > SMA200[t-1].
candidates.entry: Long when ALL on the same closed bar: (1) SMA200 rising; (2) squeeze: |SMA20 - SMA200| / SMA200 < 1%; (3) bullish candle (close > open); (4) close > SMA20 AND close > SMA200 -> enter long at that close.
candidates.exit: Exit at the close of the first bar that closes below SMA200 (this is also the stop). Optional partial profit-taking mentioned but not specified. Our variants: SOLT preset multiples.
candidates.stop: Close below SMA200 (entries were 0.5%-1.2% above SMA200 in examples).
candidates.short_mirror: SMA200 falling, squeeze <1%, bearish candle closing below both MAs -> short; exit on close above SMA200.

unspecified_params.chop_filter: video: stop trading when closes cross SMA200 very often (example 15 crosses in ~1 week); test 'skip if >= N crosses of SMA200 in last 42 bars', N in {4,6,8}

candidates.claimed_performance: Examples: +56% in ~2 months, short +22% in 50 days, long +20% in 48 days, recent +5% in 3 weeks. 'Many small losses, occasional large win'. No statistics.
candidates.relevance: MEDIUM-LOW for precise bottoms (waits for 4h SMA200 to turn up), but useful as a post-bottom regime confirmation / second entry and as a rule that forbids premature longs (example: price above a still-falling SMA200 with 4% gap -> wait).
candidates.weaknesses: 1% threshold arbitrary; whipsaw in flat SMA200 periods.

candidates.name: John Bollinger band breakout + MFI confirmation (볼린저밴드 돌파)
candidates.source_title: 볼린저밴드 개발자가 직접 알려주는 진짜 매매법 [볼린저밴드 돌파 매매법]
candidates.timeframe: 30m (video tuned the indicator to BTC 30m; claims tests from 1m to 1D)
candidates.indicators: Bollinger Bands(20, 2.0) [middle = 20-bar mean; '95% inside'], MFI (period not stated; default 14)
candidates.entry: Long: bar p closes above upper band with MFI >= 85 -> preliminary signal (no trade). If within the next 10 bars another bar closes above the upper band with MFI >= 85 -> enter long at that bar's close.
candidates.exit: Exit at the close of the first bar that closes below the middle band. Our variants: SOLT preset multiples.
candidates.stop: Lowest low of the 5 bars before entry.
candidates.short_mirror: Close below lower band with MFI <= 15 (preliminary), second such close within 10 bars -> short; stop = highest high of prior 5 bars; exit on close above middle band.

unspecified_params.second_signal_counting: video: 'within ten bars after the first breakout'; whether a new first signal resets the window is not stated

candidates.claimed_performance: Examples: long +3.6% (19h), loser <-1%, short +6%, crash-day short +11%; first-signal entry would have lost 3.5% (second never came). No statistics.
candidates.relevance: MEDIUM-LOW: long side is momentum breakout off a low (V-reversal confirmation). Our adaptation (not in video): the SHORT trigger (repeated closes below lower band with MFI<=15) marks capitulation legs — test 'arm a bottom-buy only after this condition has fired and then stopped for N bars'.
candidates.weaknesses: Fixed 85/15 thresholds; 30m scalp scale; selected examples.

not_selected_but_testable.name: Turtle 20/10 breakout with SMA200 filter, ATR*2 initial stop, close-below-10-bar-low trailing exit
not_selected_but_testable.why_not: Long only above SMA200 -> cannot buy near a bottom; but its trailing exit is a useful comparison to fixed-multiple exits.

not_selected_but_testable.name: Hull MA band color flip; stop = lowest low of 5 bars before entry; 50% at 1.5R, rest at color flip
not_selected_but_testable.why_not: HMA length not stated; near-duplicate of candidate 5.

not_selected_but_testable.name: Clean MACD (gray neutral band; +2% TP; stop prior low)
not_selected_but_testable.why_not: Neutral-band formula undisclosed; +2% scalps. Video claims BTC 4h 3y 82/105 and ETH 89/108 hit +2% (no stop-size/fee info).

Kell contraction breakout (EMA10/20/50, skip first signal after decline, exit close<EMA20)

not_selected_but_testable.why_not: Trend continuation; 'ADX low enough' not quantified.

Kullamagi box breakout (EMA10/20/50, breakout volume >= 2x box average; exits close<EMA10 half, close<EMA20 rest)
